app_fee.value: The KHYS doctorate pages fetched state no application fee; they only say no tuition is charged for a doctorate.
app_fee.quote: When pursuing a doctorate at KIT, no tuition fees will be charged

fee_waiver.value: No application fee or application-fee waiver is stated on the KHYS pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the KHYS doctoral pages; each department's doctoral regulations set admission.

toefl_min.value: KIT expects a very good command of English, but the page says formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required and gives no minimum score.
toefl_min.quote: As a rule, doctoral candidates are expected to have a very good command of English, even if formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required

ielts_min.value: KIT expects a very good command of English, but the page says formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required and gives no minimum band.
ielts_min.quote: As a rule, doctoral candidates are expected to have a very good command of English, even if formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required

english_waiver.value: The KHYS pages do not mention India or English-medium degrees; the language requirement is set with the supervisor.
english_waiver.quote: Please note that you must clarify the language requirements for the doctorate with your supervisor

notes: Umbrella rules from KHYS: admission is by each KIT department under its doctoral regulations. Department pages checked: Physics, Mathematics, Informatics, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering/Geo and Environmental Sciences, Chemical and Process Engineering. Not usable: Chemistry and Biosciences PhD page (application form only), ETIT doctoral page (no admission rules). Graduate schools with own portals (KSOP, KSETA, KSQM, GRACE, BIF-IGS, KCDS) were not saved as overrides.
